title: Rockaway finale credit, full reward dispatch and fragment admission
status: Fixed pre-credit fragment admission for unrewardable rotations; production-function and linked native outro checks pass. Client/integrated persistence verification remains pending.

finding.before: Rockaway::Eligible checked an incomplete accepted task and native outdoor eligibility but did not call CanRewardWorldQuest. A stale accepted/incomplete44746 with an unexpired personal completion, or an active rotation with a null reward template, could pass Finish and receive142487 fragments. The existing CompleteQuest guard then correctly rejected the WQ reward. Subsequent encounter completions could grant more fragments while that stale task remained incomplete.
finding.reproduction: Pinned65c7ac0a Eligible + actual current Finish/AutoStoreLoot/KilledMonsterCredit/CompleteQuest/RewardQuest reproduce both states. Two controlled completed-run Finish invocations grant20 fragments from a10-fragment loot fixture, with one objective credit, no WQ reward and no completion transaction. This is a bounded executable regression, not an observed client exploit.

implementation.change: Rockaway::Eligible now requires Player::CanRewardWorldQuest before combat target/finish recipient admission. The shared native gate checks the live rotation, reward template, strict expiry and personal completion before any optional fragment loot. Existing faction/phase/range/group/contributor and incomplete-state gates remain.
implementation.scope: No generic Player, inventory, mail, SQL reward, rotation duration, encounter placement, spell or personal-state change. No forced rotation or client action.

full_bags_assessment.decision: No new fragment mail or deferred quest completion was introduced. Native behavior is now executed and documented, but original7.3.5 Rockaway full-bag behavior remains unverified.

external_reference.title: Blizzard Support: Didn't Receive Loot Due to Full Inventory
external_reference.evidence: Official search-index excerpt explicitly excludes quest items from Postmaster delivery. Full-page fetch redirects/fails; this is contemporary general corroboration for avoiding an invented quest-fragment mail route, not proof of the original7.3.5 encounter behavior.

fixture_boundaries: The completion regression uses controlled Player/object/map/loot/inventory/database services, with full extracted production functions. It is not a linked real Player/session. Loot RNG and allowed-item decision, inventory placement, dynamic RewardWorldQuestItem delivery sink, currency/reputation effects, packets, spell playback and transaction commit are controlled leaves.

The separate linked outro test uses a real Creature surrogate at the existing map1220 test location, not a player at Rockaway. It verifies engine creation/payload/lifetime, not player visibility, subtitles, voice, visual timing or cleanup in the client.

Native save/load statement sinks and the existing separate temporary-table SQL round-trip do not establish successful real character/item/mail persistence, rollback or crash recovery. Earlier dynamic-item delivery and encounter authenticity limitations remain.

Full bags, null reward template and stale accepted/personal-completed states are injected in local fixtures. No actual inventory filled, quest state changed, retrieval mail sent or live rotation forced.
